annotation_protocol.arbitration: Disagreements between annotators are resolved by a third senior reviewer.  Inter-annotator agreement is measured with Cohen's kappa; pairs below 0.6 are re-annotated.
annotation_protocol.skill_labels: Annotators map free-text skill mentions to canonical skill names defined in scripts/job_taxonomy.py SKILL_ALIASES. Skills not covered by the taxonomy should be noted in annotation_notes for taxonomy expansion.
